findings.summary: validate="many_to_one" raises MergeError if customers has duplicate customer_id values, so callers must be aware the function can raise.
If region has a categorical dtype, fillna("unknown") raises because "unknown" is not an existing category.
count on order_id skips NaN, so orders with null order_id are omitted from the orders count while their revenue is still summed; size() would count all rows.
sum treats NaN amount_cents as 0, so such orders count toward orders but contribute no revenue.
sort_values is not stable by default, so regions with equal revenue may appear in non-deterministic order; use kind="stable" or a secondary sort key.
